out_of_hospital_midwife.kit_ordering: Out-of-hospital providers order newborn screening collection cards through the Missouri State Public Health Laboratory (MoSHL). Supplies are requested via the DHSS Newborn Screening supply ordering process.
out_of_hospital_midwife.submission_deadline: Blood specimen collected 24-48 hours of age; repeat screen required if first collected before 24 hours.
out_of_hospital_midwife.specimen_tracking: Results returned to the ordering provider; parents receive results from their provider. Tracking via the DHSS Newborn Screening portal.

hearing_screening.program_name: Missouri Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI)
hearing_screening.out_of_hospital_path: For home/birth-center births, the midwife performs or arranges the newborn hearing screen and documents results; refusal is documented in writing in the medical record per Mo. Rev. Stat. 191.330.
hearing_screening.statute: Mo. Rev. Stat. ÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂ§ 191.330 (includes hearing screening); MO EHDI 1-3-6 benchmarks

cchd_screening.out_of_hospital_performer: The attending midwife or physician performs pulse oximetry (CCHD) in the out-of-hospital setting and documents it; refusal documented per Mo. Rev. Stat. 191.330.
cchd_screening.statute: Mo. Rev. Stat. ÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂ§ 191.330 (critical congenital heart defect screening)

erythromycin_eye_ointment.waiver: Prophylactic eye treatment is required under the Prevention of Blindness rule; a parent may refuse on religious grounds (consistent with Mo. Rev. Stat. 191.330) and the refusal is documented in the medical record. Missouri issues no separate standalone waiver form beyond documented informed refusal.
erythromycin_eye_ointment.note: Approved prophylactic (e.g., erythromycin) applied to each eye shortly after birth to prevent ophthalmia neonatorum.

vitamin_k.note: Missouri does not mandate vitamin K; parental choice of oral, intramuscular shot, or decline, documented in the birth record.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.birth_dose_registry: Missouri Immunization Information System (MO IIS / ShowMeVax)
hepatitis_b_vaccine.note: Birth dose reported to MO IIS (ShowMeVax) by birthing facilities; infants born to HBsAg-positive mothers are referred for Hepatitis B case management.

gestational_diabetes.midwife_role: Licensed midwives in Missouri provide gestational diabetes screening/counseling in prenatal care and refer for diagnostic testing when indicated.
gestational_diabetes.note: Prenatal informed-choice item; no state newborn-screening form.

group_b_strep.midwife_role: Licensed midwives offer GBS screening in late pregnancy and arrange intrapartum prophylaxis per protocol for out-of-hospital births when indicated.
group_b_strep.note: Prenatal informed-choice item; no state newborn-screening form.
